schema_note: Every metric/capability the factory has considered building, classified into exactly one of REAL / ESTIMATED / DISCOVERY (ADR-040). REAL = computed from verified data. ESTIMATED = an explainable model over available evidence, must expose confidence/assumptions/missing_evidence. DISCOVERY = not computable yet — action_plan says exactly what would make it real, never a placeholder number.

capabilities.name: Risk Score
capabilities.source: safety_filter.py.evaluate() (content blocklist) + REJECTED_NICHES.md (circuit breaker) — profit_oracle.py's _score_risk(), ADR-039

capabilities.name: Automation Potential (per tier)
capabilities.source: Fixed, documented per-tier constant reflecting today's actual production capability (Tier 4 fully automatic today; Tier 1 needs infra that doesn't exist yet) — profit_oracle.py's AUTOMATION_POTENTIAL_BY_TIER, ADR-026

capabilities.name: Long-Term Value (per tier)
capabilities.source: Fixed, documented per-tier constant (Tier 1's recurring-revenue ceiling vs Tier 4's one-off nature) — profit_oracle.py's LONG_TERM_VALUE_BY_TIER, ADR-026

capabilities.name: Minimum Viable Price (Butter Price)
capabilities.source: Constitutional constant (CONSTITUTION.md §16) + config/economics.json's real per-platform floors — profit_oracle.py's butter_price()

capabilities.name: Demand (with real external signal)
assumptions: HN points / GitHub stars are a valid proxy for market demand
log-scale curve calibrated on 8 real observed candidates is representative of the wider distribution
capabilities.missing_evidence: No real sales-conversion data yet linking HN/GitHub engagement to actual purchases — the curve is a first-pass calibration, not a validated predictor.

capabilities.name: Demand (keyword/word-count only)
capabilities.source: Word-count + seasonal-keyword heuristic — profit_oracle.py's _score_demand() default path
assumptions: Niche phrase word count correlates with search specificity
Seasonal keyword list covers the real seasonal patterns that matter
capabilities.missing_evidence: No live Google Trends / search-volume connection exists (n8n Sensing Engine built but inactive — see BLOCKERS.md #1).

capabilities.name: Competition (real saved Amazon report)
capabilities.source: niche_validator_v2.py's saved report, when one exists for the niche — profit_oracle.py's _score_competition()
assumptions: Amazon search-result count is a fair proxy for competition intensity
capabilities.missing_evidence: Reports are point-in-time snapshots, manually gathered — not a live, continuously-refreshed feed.

capabilities.name: Competition (real HN/GitHub result count)
capabilities.source: external_signal.competition.related_results_count, now automatically gatherable via competitor_discovery.py (ADR-042) — profit_oracle.py's _score_competition(), ADR-041
assumptions: Number of similar real HN/GitHub results is a fair proxy for how crowded a niche is
Log-scale decay curve (calibrated as a first pass, no real data behind the specific curve shape yet) is the right shape
capabilities.missing_evidence: No real sales-outcome data yet linking result-count to actual competitive difficulty.

capabilities.name: Automated Competitor Discovery + Classification
capabilities.source: competitor_discovery.py (ADR-042) — real, automated HN/GitHub queries, explainable classification into Direct/Indirect/Alternative/Enterprise/Emerging/Unclassified, real per-competitor metrics (stars, forks, last-updated, dev velocity) with a persistent, freshness-cached database (data/competitor_database.json)
capabilities.confidence: medium for classification of strong-signal competitors (>500 GitHub stars or >100 HN points); low-to-unclassified for weak-signal hits, by design — no forced guess
assumptions: GitHub owner type (Organization vs User) + star count is a fair proxy for enterprise vs. indie
Repo age + moderate stars is a fair proxy for 'emerging startup'
capabilities.missing_evidence: Reddit mentions, Google Trends, Product Hunt, website visits, SEO rank, company size, and pricing model are explicitly returned as Unknown with a stated reason per-field (not silently omitted) — no free, keyless real source exists for any of them today.

capabilities.name: Competition (keyword specificity guess)
assumptions: A longer, more specific niche phrase implies lower competition
capabilities.missing_evidence: No real data at all when no saved report or external competitor-count signal exists — pure text-pattern guess.

capabilities.name: Margin — real platform fees + real logged AI cost
capabilities.source: economics.net_profit() over config/economics.json's real gumroad_digital fee schedule, minus real average cost from data/ai_cost_log.jsonl (book_generator.py's _log_ai_cost(), ADR-041) when any exists
capabilities.confidence: medium (fees are exact and real; AI cost is real once logged, currently sparse/empty since this logging just started)
assumptions: gumroad_digital is the representative channel for fee purposes even before other channels have live tokens
capabilities.missing_evidence: AI cost log has near-zero real entries yet (logging only started today) — the average will strengthen automatically as real production continues, no code change needed.

capabilities.name: Profit Margin / Price Tier (the price estimate itself)
assumptions: Presence of words like 'template'/'course'/'system' predicts a higher achievable price
capabilities.missing_evidence: No real pricing A/B test or sales history exists yet to validate any price point — this is distinct from margin_real_fees_and_cost above, which is real once a price is assumed.

capabilities.name: Execution Fit / Technical Complexity / Time-to-Market
capabilities.source: Digital-vs-physical keyword check against real production capability (book_engine) — profit_oracle.py's _score_execution()
assumptions: A niche not matching PHYSICAL_PRODUCT_KEYWORDS can be produced by the existing book_engine
capabilities.missing_evidence: No real per-product generation-time measurement feeds this yet, even though book_generator.py's logs contain the raw data to compute one.

capabilities.name: Confidence Score
capabilities.source: Deterministic function of which other components actually used real data this call — profit_oracle.py's _score_confidence(), ADR-039
capabilities.note: Meta-level: this one is REAL, not ESTIMATED, because it's a direct computation over known facts (was external_signal present? was a real report found?), not a guess about an unknown.

capabilities.name: Pricing Power
capabilities.action_plan: Requires real price-sensitivity data: at least one live sales channel (BLOCKERS.md #2) with several real transactions at varying price points for comparable products. Cannot be estimated honestly before a single real sale exists.

capabilities.name: Customer Pain
capabilities.action_plan: Requires real customer input: reviews, support tickets, or survey responses. Blocked entirely on having any customers at all (zero today).

capabilities.name: Market Growth
capabilities.action_plan: Requires the SAME metric measured at multiple points in time to compute a growth rate. Today's research batches (tier1_intake/) are single snapshots. Unlock: start storing dated snapshots of the same real signals (HN points, GitHub stars) for the same candidates over weeks/months.

capabilities.name: Search Trend
capabilities.action_plan: Requires a live Google Trends connection. The n8n Sensing Engine workflow already exists for exactly this and is structurally complete (ADR-037) — unlock is: activate it (needs n8n login, BLOCKERS.md #1), not new engineering.

capabilities.name: Social Trend
capabilities.action_plan: Requires a social media API connection (e.g. Reddit, X/Twitter) with real credentials — none exist today. Falls under BLOCKERS.md's 'external credentials' category if pursued.

capabilities.name: B2B Potential
capabilities.action_plan: A real B2B/B2C classifier needs training data (real buyer-type outcomes), not a keyword guess — building it from keywords alone would repeat the exact ADR-036 mistake. Unlock: once real sales exist, tag buyer type per sale and train from that.

capabilities.name: B2C Potential
capabilities.action_plan: Same as b2b_potential — inverse of the same unlock.

capabilities.name: SaaS Potential
capabilities.action_plan: No hosting/billing/subscription infrastructure exists (ELITE_ASSET_DOCTRINE.md §6) to validate any SaaS hypothesis against. Unlock: build minimal real subscription infra first, or don't score this dimension.

capabilities.name: AI Leverage
capabilities.action_plan: No agreed, computable definition exists yet for what this number would even measure. Unlock: define a precise formula (e.g. 'hours of human work replaced per unit produced') before attempting to compute it.

capabilities.name: Virality
capabilities.action_plan: Requires real share/mention tracking on a live product — no product is live on any channel yet (BLOCKERS.md #2/#3).

capabilities.name: Maintenance Cost
capabilities.action_plan: Requires operational cost data over a longer real time window than 13 days. Unlock: track real time-spent-per-product-type across more production cycles.

capabilities.name: Revenue Recurrence
capabilities.action_plan: Requires real repeat-purchase data. Unlock: once any real sales exist, compute this directly from sales_ledger.jsonl instead of guessing from the word 'subscription' in a niche name.

capabilities.name: Customer Lifetime Value
capabilities.action_plan: Requires real, multi-purchase customer history. Blocked entirely on having any customers (zero today).

capabilities.name: Upsell Potential
capabilities.action_plan: Same blocker as customer_lifetime_value — needs a real customer base first.

capabilities.name: Cross-sell Potential
capabilities.action_plan: Same blocker as customer_lifetime_value — needs a real customer base first.

capabilities.name: Defensibility / Competitive Moat
capabilities.action_plan: Requires a real competitive-intelligence process (tracking specific competitors' offers/pricing over time) — none exists. Unlock: define which 3-5 real competitors to track and what signal to record, then track it for a real period before scoring this.

capabilities.name: Market Saturation
capabilities.action_plan: Distinct from competition_score (which measures search-result density for one niche) — this needs real total-addressable-market sizing, which no tool in this factory computes. Until then, use competition_score as the closest real proxy rather than inventing a separate number for the same underlying question.
